fuss_with_metadata: add a runtime metadata entry to gRPC invocation metadata tuples or return empty metadata
rpc_names: build a dictionary mapping fully qualified RPC names to their method descriptors from service descriptors
create_ChannelRpcRead: create a ChannelRpcRead namedtuple with response, trailing_metadata, code, and details fields for client RPC reads
create_ServerRpcRead: create a ServerRpcRead namedtuple with request, requests_closed, and terminated fields for server RPC reads
use_REQUESTS_CLOSED_TERMINATED: use the REQUESTS_CLOSED and TERMINATED sentinel ServerRpcRead constants to signal stream state changes
